newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha swaps up $2 on mogas, futures gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha swaps up $2 on mogas, futures gains.

text.p: A quiet naphtha market Monday did little more than react to movements on the screen and to an extremely buoyant prompt gasoline market, both of which factors helped to raise August naphtha swaps by around $2 on the day.
A naphtha swap trade was heard during the afternoon at $191.50, underlining the $2 gain, as September swaps were talked in the $188-$189 range, $1-$1.50 up on the day.

No fresh physical trades and precious little evidence of fixed price talk were reported by dealers after the $193.25 sale Friday of a pipeline spec cargo by a petchem end-user to a London-based trader for second half August loading.

Brokers referred to poor petchem demand for naphtha, a position exacerbated by ethylene cracker outages in Tarragona and Terneuzen, although Repsol said the former resumed production Saturday while Dow said the latter would stay down until around August 12 to 15.
The rapidly widening mogas/naphtha spread was yet to bring out significant interest in buying of napthenic and aromatic naphtha, dealers said.
